title: Rapid Point-of-Care Testing for SARS-CoV-2 Using Cap-iLAMP
author: Lukas Bokelmann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1344/v1

steps.title: Prepare 1x Lysis Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1x concentrated Lysis Binding Buffer (LysBB) by mixing 2ml of 2x concentrated LysBB with 2ml of water.

steps.title: Prepare and Wash Dynabeads
steps.instruction: Prepare Dynabeads™ MyOne™ Streptavidin C1 in 1.5ml tubes (up to 15 reactions can be prepared in one tube).

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20µl of beads per reaction to the tubes.
Place tubes in a magnetic rack and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 500µl 1x LysBB, place in a magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Repeat the wash step once more.

steps.title: Bind Oligonucleotides to Beads
steps.instruction: Bind the oligonucleotides to the washed beads at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 100µl 1x LysBB per reaction.
Add 2µl of CV2 btn (100 µM) and 2µl CV16bt n (100 µM) per reaction.
Rotate tubes for 10min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and Treat Beads
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes and an alkaline melt treatment.

substeps.instruction: Place tube on a magnetic rack and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend in 40µl alkaline melt solution per reaction.
Incubate the suspension for 5min at room temperature.
Place tube in a magnetic rack and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 40µl 1x LysBB per reaction, place in a magnetic rack, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare Bead Suspension for Sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the final bead suspension for the capture process.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the washed beads in 100µl 2x LysBB per reaction.
If multiple reactions were prepared at once, distribute 100µl of suspension into single 1.5ml tubes.
Add 400µl 2x LysBB to each tube to reach a total volume of 500µl.

steps.title: Capture Target RNA
steps.instruction: Add the sample to the bead suspension and incubate to capture the target.

substeps.instruction: Add 500µl of sample (e.g., gargle lavage), or 500µl water (negative control), or 499.5µl water and 0.5µl synthetic SARS-CoV-2 RNA control 2 (positive control) to the 500µl bead suspension.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 55°C for 10min.
Place the suspension on a magnetic rack and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash Captured Beads
steps.instruction: Clean the captured beads using wash and low salt buffers.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 200µl wash buffer, place on a magnetic rack, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat this wash step once.
Resuspend the beads in 200µl low salt buffer, place on a magnetic rack, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Elute Target RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the captured RNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 25µl elution buffer.
Incubate at 60°C for 2min.
Place the reaction on a magnetic rack, transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube, and discard the beads.

steps.title: Perform LAMP Reaction
steps.instruction: Amplify the eluted target using LAMP and SYBR green I.

substeps.instruction: Add 10µl of eluate to 20µl of LAMP master mix and mix by pipetting.
Add 0.5µl of SYBR green I to the cap of the tube, ensuring it does not contact the reaction volume.
Incubate the reactions for 40min at 65°C.

steps.title: Record and Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction and determine the outcome via colorimetric analysis.

substeps.instruction: Shake the tube to mix the reaction volume with the SYBR green I in the cap.
Take photos with a smartphone.
Extract hue values using a color picker app (e.g., ‘Palette Cam’, ‘Color Grab’, or ‘Aurora’) or a web tool/Excel formula to score RGB and convert to hue.
